tagline: Quality outdoor equipment and expert service, since 2012
heroSubheading: Quality outdoor gear and expert service from your local STIHL Shop.
aboutHtml:
Michael and Roanne took over STIHL Shop Warkworth in 2012 and set about stocking the best outdoor equipment we could find. We're here because we believe good gear matters, and that it deserves proper service and advice to match.

We stock the full STIHL range in petrol and battery models, alongside MASPORT, CUBCADET and CANYCOM mowers, HONDA generators and inverters, garden tools from SILKY, NIWASHI and OKASUNE, and premium BBQs from Ziegler, Brown and Big Green Egg. Our workshop is fully equipped to service and repair everything we sell. We sharpen chainsaw chains and garden tools, work on ride-on mowers, and can arrange pickup and delivery if you need it.

Come in and see us. We'll help you get sorted with the right equipment and back up your investment for the life of the product.
servicesIntro: Bring your gear in for servicing, repairs, and specialised sharpening, or we can come to you.
